video_title: Trevor Ariza on How LeBron Got Cheated, Being a Basketball Dad, Kobe, Lakers, Chris Paul & More

quotes.speaker: Trevor Ariza
quotes.summary_phrase: Trevor Ariza on the Suns drafting Deandre Ayton over Luka Doncic
quotes.excerpt: if Luka would have been there, I probably wouldn't have been there
quotes.quote: When I was there, I didn't really hear any of that. After they drafted Deandre Ayton, I believe they just, I don't even know. Honestly, I can't tell you if there was blowback or anything. But if Luka would have been there, I probably wouldn't have been there. So, you know, thank you.

quotes.speaker: Trevor Ariza
quotes.summary_phrase: Trevor Ariza on Devin Booker's work ethic and desire to improve
quotes.excerpt: I watched him work his ass off. I watched him continue to try to find ways
quotes.quote: I watched him work his ass off. I watched him continue to try to find ways to be as good as he can. I saw him outwork everybody, and he just had that want to take the next step in his career at that time. He was pressing for that. He wanted every moment. He wanted to be in every moment where it all fell on his shoulders.

quotes.speaker: Trevor Ariza
quotes.summary_phrase: Trevor Ariza on the importance of parents having kids born in the US or UK
quotes.excerpt: a lot of the parents try to have their kids be born in the States or the UK
quotes.quote: Both of my parents, my whole family is from Turks and Caicos. Usually, around, I guess my time, even now, a lot of the parents try to have their kids be born in the States or the UK just for more opportunities and a bigger world, for lack of better words, and more opportunities to be able to go into whatever field that there is out there for you.

quotes.speaker: Trevor Ariza
quotes.summary_phrase: Trevor Ariza on the difficulty of shooting in the playoffs
quotes.excerpt: sometimes when you're training, when you shoot, they have this thing that you put on the rim
quotes.quote: Sometimes when you're training, when you shoot, they have this thing that you put on the rim that makes the rim a little bit smaller. So in order for the ball, for you to make the shot, it's got to be, it's got to be perfect. I feel like one of those lids was on that on the second half of the game.

quotes.speaker: Trevor Ariza
quotes.summary_phrase: Trevor Ariza on the 2018 Rockets being one of the best teams ever
quotes.excerpt: statistically probably the best team. We had Harden MVP season, right? CP cooking, and just just shooters
quotes.quote: It is probably the one of the best teams. Statistically probably the best team. We had Harden MVP season, right? CP cooking, and just just shooters. Pat, wait, Pat wasn't there. We had Tuck, Luke, myself. Those are three pieces that you could just move around. Then you had Clint back there, young Clint Capela, who could guard, you know, a lob threat, protect the rim. Then you had Nene coming in, who switched, who switched it up, switched up styles when he came in the game, very aggressive on defense, very smart, able to, you know, kind of quarterback the defense. And then we had Jeff Bzdelik, what a lot of people don't really know, who was one of the defensive coaches, who he coached with with George Karl for a long time, right? And he just was brilliant, and he brought in, you know, our schemes with with our personnel, and the combination of what we had, him and coach D'Antoni for the offense, it was like we had all the tools necessary to win a championship. We just again, fucked around and went cold.

quotes.speaker: Trevor Ariza
quotes.summary_phrase: Trevor Ariza on Phil Jackson's ability to manage player personalities
quotes.excerpt: he knows how to I believe he does a really good job of managing personalities
quotes.quote: In the moment, Phil is like, he knows how to I believe he does a really good job of managing personalities, because there's a system that's already in place. The only thing you got to do is continue to learn the system and work. So, being able to to manage like big egos and superstar players and make them mesh well with role players or players that don't play that much to get to get the most out of everybody, I feel like you got to be a great like manipulator of of managing minds.

quotes.speaker: Trevor Ariza
quotes.summary_phrase: Trevor Ariza on the business side of being an NBA player
quotes.excerpt: there's two parts to this, right? There's the player, the competitor and then there's the businessman
quotes.quote: There's two parts to this, right? There's the player, the competitor and then there's the businessman. So as players, emotionally we be like into the game, into the the players that you play with. But then like there's a business side to it, right? And understanding like worth and what you are and what you bring, there's a value on that, right? Regardless of how old you are, how long you've been doing something, there's a value for that.

quotes.speaker: Trevor Ariza
quotes.summary_phrase: Trevor Ariza on the importance of constructive criticism in basketball
quotes.excerpt: the thing that I believe helps kids from my perspective and only mine is when they listen
quotes.quote: The thing that I believe helps kids from my perspective and only mine is when they listen, when they are able to take constructive criticism positively and they understand what it means. And when you just have kids that just love to love to work.

quotes.speaker: Trevor Ariza
quotes.summary_phrase: Trevor Ariza on the importance of fundamentals like rebounding and defense
quotes.excerpt: the thing that you should be teaching the kids from again just my humble opinion is how to communicate
quotes.quote: The thing that you should be teaching the kids from again just my humble opinion is how to communicate on the court, rebounding, right? And just being able just to play hard every single time you're on the court. Those are the most important things to the game to me. I mean, scoring is obviously important. But like every, you want your coach to feel good about you being out there if your shots cold. If you're doing everything else right.

quotes.summary_phrase: Trevor Ariza on the difficulty of playing on a tanking team

quotes.quote: As a competitor and at that point in my career, it's like miserable because I've won pretty much like all the places that I've been from high school to, you know, all the way. So, you know, when you are when you like to compete, when you like to win, more than you like when you hate losing more than you like to win, you know, that's being on a team that's tanking is like miserable.

quotes.speaker: Trevor Ariza
quotes.summary_phrase: Trevor Ariza on the Lakers' meditation sessions
quotes.excerpt: when when I play for the Lakers, we used to do a lot of meditating before we watch film
quotes.quote: When when I play for the Lakers, we used to do a lot of meditating before we watch film. So and in the playoffs, there were there were themes to each series and like each series was it shaped differently, right? So they used to pick out movies that was similar to the opponent. Yeah. In our film sessions, he would put clips of different parts of the movie, like so it'd be like a 10-minute clip to get you locked in, right?
